bends.note: 8th runs straight east-west east of x ~570 and angles up to the north-west (parallel to the other diagonal streets) west of it

ends.note: School Alley (printed SCHOOL, 10 ft) runs west from John Street and stops at the school lot at x ~1662

notes: The streets west of John are angled (Mound runs NNE-SSW and the E-W streets tilt down to the east west of John). The Mound points use the four block corners and the water-main crossing. Mound/8th is off the sheet (it would fall west of the paper edge, x ~200). Central Avenue lies along the east edge: only its west block line (x ~3775-3785) is drawn and the scan ends at about x 3930, so the Central points are the west line plus half of the 60 ft printed near Elizabeth (about 103 px). That could be off by up to about 30 px if the street is narrower further south (a '50'' label near 8th may also belong to Central). Court, Richmond, 9th and 8th continue east of Central on sheet 54 per the key map, so they are recorded as crossings. Elizabeth/Central is a T as drawn. The 9th-8th alley east of John is printed only ALLEY (10 ft) and runs from John to Central. It lines up with School Alley west of John, so John/School Alley is a crossing and its Central end is a T with ''. Elizabeth is printed 50' on its angled part near Mound but measures about 60 ft (and is printed 60' near Central). No other alleys on this sheet.
